title: Load balancer (engine lb)
intro: Virtual IPs spread over application servers by Maglev hashing; GRE, L3DSR or NAT to the server.

notice.title: Write-only in the engine:
notice.body: The engine cannot report load-balancer objects correctly, so the live state below comes from the engine's own lists. A deleted or changed VIP stays in the engine as "removed" (with its servers) until the lb garbage collection, which only the globals owner runs (about a minute after the last delete) — or until the engine restarts. There are no health checks and no L7 proxying: a server stays in rotation until you remove it here.

vips.title: Virtual IPs
vips.vppTotal: The engine lists {{count}} lb VIP entries (all owners, removed included)

settings.title: Global settings and NAT interfaces
settings.intro: The settings are engine-wide (lb_conf): only the globals owner applies them. NAT VIPs need the NAT feature on the interface the servers answer on.
